latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of enterprise-sales-coach: an end-to-end coaching tool for B2B enterprise and mid-market sales.
- Guides founders, AEs, SDRs, and sales leaders through every stage—ICP/buyer persona, outbound/inbound/ABM, discovery/qualification (MEDDPICC, BANT, SPIN), demo/POC, procurement/legal/security, pricing/negotiation, close plans, retention/expansion, and sales team scaling.
- Includes a diagnostic sweep with 16 targeted questions to assess product, pipeline health, deal process, and sales operations before giving recommendations.
- Offers best practices for ICP sharpening, sales process definition, deal management, pipeline hygiene, team compensation, and PLG vs. sales-led.
- Designed to activate on common B2B sales terms, frameworks, and pain points—ensuring focused, actionable advice for real-world sales challenges.
